text:
elaine_sales: Quick ask — Northbridge Analytics procurement is pushing for Net30 (we normally do Net15) and wants a partial upfront schedule for an annual prepay. They're ok with a 30% upfront, then two follow-up invoices. Need finance + deal desk approval before I send counters. ACV is $240k, recommended discount 15% (we already cut a bit on list).

miguel_se: FYI technical POC is green. SE signed off on data residency. POC timeline doesn't need cash hold but procurement insists on invoice terms for legal.

elaine_sales: Proposed invoice schedule (customer provided):
```
Invoice 1: 30% of contract value on PO receipt (Net30)
Invoice 2: 35% 30 days after contract start (Net30)
Invoice 3: 35% 60 days after contract start (Net30)
```

chris_salesops: Can you attach the quote + PO? Also need GL code and whether this is prepay or credit. For accounting, Net30 on an upfront invoice is an exception — we usually require upfront payment to be Net15 or prepaid.

elaine_sales: attaching quote now — link https://redwood.internal/sales/quotes/nb-2026-Q1 (customer sent PO as pdf). They labeled it 'Net30 on first invoice' and want invoices shipped to AP@northbridge.com.

lindsey_deals: Need justification for deviating from standard. Please include: 1) commercial reason (strategic customer / reference), 2) risk mitigation (SOW, escrow, limits), 3) proposed controls (holdback, milestone acceptance). Also include approval threshold ask: approving Net30 on upfront for <$250k ACV? My read: this needs Senior Deals approval but we can fast-track with clear mitigation.

elaine_sales: Commercial reason: target strategic log-analytics partner, enterprise reference in EMEA, co-marketing potential. Risk mitigation: signed SOW for restricted dataset handling, KMS integration, and 2-week go/no-go milestone tied to 2nd invoice.

sam_finance: Flags: Net30 on upfront increases DSO risk. If deals desk signs off, finance needs a short-term AR hold in our system and PO matched to invoice. Also confirm payment method — ACH vs check. Recommend ACH required and ask for AP contact + remittance.

abby_custsuccess: Implementation timeline is 4 weeks from start. If invoices align with milestones we can set milestone acceptance to trigger invoice 2. That reduces exposure. Happy to own milestone confirmation. :thumbsup:

lindsey_deals: Ok — with ACH-only payment, PO on file, SOW + milestone tie to invoice 2, I'm inclined to approve the exception at 15% discount and Net30 on first invoice. Need chris_salesops to confirm AR controls and sam_finance to confirm the AR hold process.

chris_salesops: Confirmed — we can set AR flag and require ACH. I'll create a billing SOP entry and add the PO number to the invoice instructions. I need the exact PO# before I finalize.

elaine_sales: PO# NB-PO-8942 (from customer pdf). I'll update the quote.

sam_finance: I can approve the AR hold for this transaction and coordinate with accounting. Please add a note in the deal that ACH is required and remittance to our lockbox. Once billing ops confirms SOP entry, finance signs off.

lindsey_deals: Recording approval notes: Net30 exception on first invoice only; ACH-only; PO on file (NB-PO-8942); SOW + milestone for invoice 2; ACV $240k; discount 15%. I'll sign this off in deals queue once SOP entry is visible.

elaine_sales: Thanks all. Will update the quote and send counter.

rb_deploybot: Billing SOP created (SOP-2026-114) and linked to deal.

chris_salesops: Added SOP link to deal record. We're good to proceed. :white_check_mark:

elaine_sales: Sending counteroffer to procurement now. I'll paste final language here after send.

(attachments: NB-PO-8942.pdf, quote-NB-240k-v3.pdf)
